messages.subject: January time entries — please finalise by 4 February
messages.plaintextBody:
All fee-earners,

January time entries must be finalised in the practice management system by close of business on 4 February to allow billing to run. There are currently unposted entries against several matters. Please also clear any narratives marked 'draft'.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
